title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.01800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. translated_title: LineupRL：通过“描述到序列识别”实现时间序列描述的可验证强化学习
translated_abstract: 时间序列描述（time series captioning）是时间序列理解的基础步骤，也可以作为信号与自然语言之间的桥梁。监督微调（SFT）依赖于更大模型生成的描述，其质量无法超越后者。强化学习（RL）则有望突破这一限制，但其现有的奖励函数是为其他模态和其他任务设计的，难以很好地迁移到时间序列领域的开放式生成任务中。为此，我们提出了 LineupRL——一种基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）流程，其奖励机制为“描述到序列的识别”。该奖励模型是一个冻结的大语言模型（LLM）验证器，它以原始数值的形式读取生成的描述和候选时间序列（而非图表），并需从多个干扰项中挑选出被描述的时间序列。与撰写问题或评判描述相比，匹配任务对验证器的要求要轻得多，因此现成的LLM即可提供奖励信号。
tldr: LineupRL 提出了一种以“描述到序列识别”为可验证奖励的强化学习流程，让现成的大语言模型通过从多个干扰项中识别出被描述的时间序列来提供奖励信号，从而突破监督微调的质量上限，提升时间序列描述生成能力。
en_tdlr: LineupRL introduces an RLVR pipeline whose verifiable reward is caption-to-series identification—a frozen off-the-shelf LLM picks the described time series from distractors—enabling time series captioning to surpass the quality ceiling of supervised fine-tuning.
